name: Joe-kun
source:
Likes: Her [url=/c33365]master[/url]
Dislikes: Chocolate (it's so bitter and black)

Maradonna-sama's servant who suddenly appears at St. Maradonna Girls' School as an adults shop clerk. She also sells food and other goods, but mostly adult goods with overly high prices. Her favorite good is vibrators.
